systems.name: State Employees' Retirement System of Illinois

statute.quote: A retirement and benefit system is created to provide retirement annuities and other benefits for employees of the State of Illinois. The system shall be known as the "State Employees' Retirement System of Illinois".

source.quote: The responsibility for the operation of the system and for making effective this Article is vested in a board of trustees.

systems.name: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois

statute.quote: Effective July 1, 1939, there is created the "Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois" for the purpose of providing retirement annuities and other benefits for teachers, annuitants and beneficiaries.

body.name: Board of Trustees of the Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois

source.quote: A board of 15 members constitutes the board of trustees authorized to carry out the provisions of this Article and is responsible for the general administration of the System.

systems.name: State Universities Retirement System

statute.quote: A retirement system is created to provide retirement annuities and other benefits for employees, as defined in this Article, and their dependents. The system shall be known and may be cited as State Universities Retirement System.

body.name: Board of Trustees of the State Universities Retirement System

source.quote: A board of trustees constituted as provided in this Section shall administer this System. The board shall be known as the Board of Trustees of the State Universities Retirement System.

website_source.quote: SURS State Universities Retirement System Member Login Active Members Retirees Retirement Plans Traditional

systems.notes: Covers employees of state universities and community colleges. Website quote is the site header.

systems.name: Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund

statute.quote: A retirement and benefit fund to be known as the "Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund" is hereby created.

body.name: Board of Trustees of the Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund

source.quote: A board of 8 members shall constitute a board of trustees authorized to carry out the provisions of this Article.

website_source.quote: IMRF members' and employers' rights and obligations are governed by Article 7 of the Illinois Pension Code.
